# @hondo/solid

Terminal-native SolidJS renderer and component library for Hondo.

Exports include renderer helpers, layout primitives, controls, typed styling, focus/event surfaces and `NativeView` bindings.

Hondo v0.1.0 is pinned to `solid-js` and `@solidjs/universal` 2.0.0-rc.4. See the repository `docs/api.md` and `docs/compatibility.md` for the complete public surface and support matrix.
